subject: Mid-quarter steer: action grid, rescope proposals, and QBR prep
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter steer: action grid, rescope proposals, and QBR prep

Team —

Quick mid-quarter readout and asks ahead of the QBR dry run next Tuesday. I wanted to surface where we are against the top-level OKRs and propose a small rescope to protect our Q4 SLAs. High-level status (brief):

- OKR: Inference latency P50 <= 120ms for Hosted API — At 135ms; trending down with kernel optimization but we have two infra blockers.
- OKR: Dedicated adoption (pilot -> GA) — Pilot customers signed, GA docs lagging (sales enablement) and a known regression in model-variant routing that increases cost for some workloads.
- OKR: Optimize unit cost — Ongoing; batching improvements ready but dependency on cache-layer fix (RED-4123).

Proposal (recommended rescope):
1) Defer non-essential perf flags and the long-tail telemetry migration to next sprint (reduces scope by ~1.5w of dev work).
2) Prioritize the cache-layer fix (RED-4123) and the routing regression patch; both required for QBR talking points.
3) Tighten QBR narrative to focus on two wins + three risks (avoid broad commitments).

Specific asks (owners + ETA please):
- Infrastructure: allocate up to 2 SRE weeks to RED-4123 (owner: ?; ETA: EOW 11/3) — this is the gating item for latency and cost slides.
- Runtime: confirm rollout plan for routing patch that reduces fallback-to-large-models (owner: Markus; ETA: 11/5).
- Product: a one-pager for GA readiness to share with Sales (owner: Laura; ETA: 11/2).
- Growth: Sales enablement playbook (owner: Vanessa; ETA: 11/4).

I attached a lightweight action grid (midq_action_grid.xlsx) and the updated QBR prep note (qbr_prep_note_v2.docx) — please review and add any missing risks. If we can lock owners and target dates by EOD, I will consolidate into the QBR slide pack and run the dry run on Monday 11/2 at 10:00 PT.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Product Strategy — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter steer: action grid, rescope proposals, and QBR prep

Naomi —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick responses:
- Sales enablement one-pager: can deliver by 11/4 but I need the GA bullets from Product (Laura) by COB 11/2.
- We can spare 2 SRE weeks for RED-4123 but need approval from Infrastructure leadership (I will escalate if Markus signs off on scope).
- I agree with tightening the narrative — fewer risks, clearer mitigation bullets.

Action: Laura, can you confirm the GA checklist items Laura -> Laura? (cc'd).

Vanessa
VP, Growth — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter steer: action grid, rescope proposals, and QBR prep

TL;DR: I can absorb the routing patch into the next rollout window but we need a simplified, single-line ownership per dependency for exec slides.

Details:
- RED-4123 (cache-layer): this is infra-heavy. If Vanessa can secure 2 SRE weeks we can target a hotfix by 11/3 for the pilot traffic; full regression tests will take through 11/10. I added a short note to JIRA: RED-4123 -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-4123.
- Routing regression: runtime team will push a canary on 11/1; ETA to full rollout 11/5 assuming no perf regressions. I'll own the rollout plan and will post a one-line status update for slides.

One small ask on rescope: if we defer telemetry migration, we should agree on a readable mitigation statement for QBR that explains the tradeoff (short-term observability loss vs. shipping low-latency). I can draft that language.

On quoting Naomi's original:
> Specific asks (owners + ETA please):
> - Infrastructure: allocate up to 2 SRE weeks to RED-4123 (owner: ?; ETA: EOW 11/3) — this is the gating item for latency and cost slides.

Markus
VP, Engineering — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha@acme-analytics.com>, Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@cloudreach.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter steer: action grid, rescope proposals, and QBR prep

Thanks everyone — consolidating action items below for visibility. I will drop this into the QBR pack and share a slide-ready one-liner per dependency. Please treat the bullets as commitments for the next checkpoint (EOD unless noted).

Action grid (owners & due dates):
- RED-4123 (cache-layer fix) — Owner: Markus (Infra support: Vanessa to secure 2 SRE weeks) — Target: hotfix to pilot by 2026-11-03; full regression by 2026-11-10.
- Routing regression patch — Owner: Markus — Canary 2026-11-01; full 2026-11-05.
- GA readiness one-pager — Owner: Laura Bennett — Due 2026-11-02 (Laura to provide bullets to Vanessa).
- Sales enablement playbook — Owner: Vanessa Ortiz — Due 2026-11-04.
- QBR dry run — Naomi to run Monday 2026-11-02 10:00 PT (slide pack in shared Drive by 2026-11-01 17:00 PT).

Notes: I accepted Markus's suggestion to draft the mitigation language around deferring telemetry migration; will post a short paragraph into the drive by EOD and flag where we should insert the tradeoff line in the QBR slide.

Attachments referenced: midq_action_grid.xlsx, qbr_prep_note_v2.docx (both in the shared Drive folder).

If there are objections to the owners/dates above, call them out now — otherwise I'll lock and move into the pack.

Naomi
Director, Product Strategy — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
